title: UCOPE B02: shared-data learned-return acquisition card
context: Claim to test: a fresh count-conditioned return learner can improve native net return over a blind model trained on the same episodes and IMMEDIATE-4. Binding: systems / information flow; this finite host does not instantiate multi-agent partial observability or non-stationarity. P07-UCOPE-CARD-01 completes selection, card and CM handoff only.

options.consequence: Retain the delegated frozen card and prepared CM handoff; no implementation or invocation has been dispatched by this preparation.

dm_reason: The matched-data blind comparison and immediate reference test useful native acquisition without a causal-diagnosis prerequisite.

packet.question: 是否保留已按P07-UCOPE-CARD-01冻结的B02卡片：用一份付费探索数据学习计数条件模型与盲模型，并以最终净收益检验信息价值？

changes_if_approved.target: UCOPE B02 science card and CM handoff
changes_if_approved.from: P07提案，尚未固定数据种子、数值更新和结果分支
changes_if_approved.to: 一个新数据种子6401、共享采样回报、两个学习模型及立即承诺对照；完整600秒上限，卡片与五项CM实施交接已准备

packet.if_refused: 在下一清晰边界撤回B02未执行部分，保留提案、B01结果及全部历史证据；方向状态和停止的保留策略分支不改变。

evidence_for.quote: Fit two models on one fresh deliberately exploratory dataset; evaluate their final purchase/duration policies against each other and IMMEDIATE-4.
evidence_for.why: 同一数据和回报控制额外信息与数据投入，立即承诺对照另行确认付费信息确有净收益。

evidence_for.quote: The new decision is whether useful acquisition can be recovered by a simple same-host value learner whose final root choice evaluates its learned conditional tail values.
evidence_for.why: 这是B01尚未回答的普通回报模型问题，无须先完成历史原因定位。

evidence_against.quote: The possible upward bias from maximizing noisy fitted means is part of the learner under test and is judged by fresh native return, not corrected with unseen oracle labels.
evidence_against.why: 回报估计噪声可能诱发有害探测；可用收益很小，必须保留每个情境的损失。

uncertainty: 一个共享数据种子不能估计训练总体不确定性，也不能建立稳定优越性。
新学习器实际耗时尚未测量，600秒是整次上限而非耗时保证。
本卡片只研究有限信息流主机，不证明多智能体效果，也不解释B01失败原因。

cost.compute: 本轮零训练、评估、实现或Send；卡片固定未来一次共360448回合、393216次标量更新、完整600秒上限。两个模型共享训练数据，不能各领600秒。
cost.owner_time: 可异步读卡片及边界，不等待回复。

packet.verdict_text: Recommendation and selection: (a). Directly learned full return and a shared-data blind comparison can test useful acquisition without diagnosing B01 first.
